parsing_res_list.block_content: The SMPC outputs the peripheral control status to the status register (SR) when the SMPC control mode is used. The status register (SR) is a registerthatcan beread without regard for the INTBACK command. However, when the register is read when the INTBACK command is not inuse,all bits except theRESB bit will be undefined.

bit7bito
SR 1PDLNPERESBP2MD1P2MDOP1MD1P1MD0
P1MD: Port1Mode00:15-byte mode (Returns peripheral data up to a maximum of15bytes.) 01:255-byte mode (Returns peripheral data up to a maximumof255bytes. 10: Unused
P2MD:11:0-byte mode (Port is not accessed.) Port2Mode 00:15-byte mode (Returns peripheral data up to a maximum of15bytes.) 01:255-byte mode (Returns peripheral data up to a maximumof255bytes.) 10:Unused
RESB:11: 0-byte mode (Port is not accessed.) ResetButtonStatusBit 0: ResetButtonOFF 1: ResetButtonON Reading without regard for INTBACKcommand is possible.(Shows status for each V-BLANK-IN.)
NPE: PDL:Remaining Peripheral Existence Bit O:No remaining data 1:Remaining data Peripheral Data LocationBit
bit7:0: 2nd or above peripheral data 1: 1st peripheral data Always1
